Name: JoJa-84-Plus--Ingame-calculator
Author: k4rakara
Description:
[size=5]JoJa 84+[/size]
JoJa 84 plus is a simple mod for Stardew Valley that allows you to make computations without having to Alt+Tab out of the game.
[size=4]
Installation[/size]
Simply download and extract the .zip file into your mods folder. Note: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] is required.

[size=4]Usage[/size]
To open the calculator, press F9. From there you can use the on-screen number pad or the one on your keyboard to preform basic calculations.
A config.json file can now be placed in the mods directory to reconfigure the key used to open the calculator.
EX:
[code]﻿{
﻿"HotKey": "F9"
}[/code]
A list of all the keys that can be used can be found [url=https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.windows.forms.keys?view=netframework-4.8]here[/url].
Enjoy!

[size=4]Bugs
[/size]If you find any bugs, feel free to report them on [url=https://github.com/K4rakara/Stardew-Mods/tree/master/JoJa84Plus]GitHub[/url]!
